title: からだと臓器のアイコン
lead: 胃・心臓・肺・脳・歯・骨など、からだの部位と臓器を分かりやすく描いたアイコン12点です。健康だよりや説明資料に使えます。
subject_en: Simple friendly anatomy icons, each ONE organ or body part, centred, flat colours, soft rounded shapes, not gory and not realistic, suitable for a health newsletter. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a simple human heart organ with two vessels
a pair of lungs with a windpipe
a brain seen from the side
a clean white molar tooth with shine marks
a long bone with rounded ends
a pair of kidney-bean shaped kidneys
a flexed arm showing a bicep muscle
